newsitem.title: USA: MEDIQ Inc Q2 revenues, net and share rise.
newsitem.headline: MEDIQ Inc Q2 revenues, net and share rise.

text.p: NOTES: 1997 Q2 pro forma results assume the sale of the company's investments in Cardinal Health Services Inc and Integrated Health Services Inc had occurred at the beginning of the period and the proceeds were used to reduce borrowings under the company's credit facility.

1997 Q2 operating share includes a portion of the gain on the disposal of the company's investment in Cardinal Health, which was $2,654,000 (net of tax) or $0.10 a share, and the gain relating to the note receivable from NutraMax Products Inc, which was $766,000 (net of tax), or $0.03 a share.

1997 Q2 net share figure includes a $0.01 a share loss from discontinued operations and an extraordinary loss of $462,000, or $0.02 a share, on the acquisition, at a premium, of certain of the company's debt and the write-off of related deferred charges.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: For six months 1997, net loss from continuing operations was $1,134,000 or $0.05 per share after a charge of $11,047,000 (net of taxes) for repurchase of warrant to acquire 10 percent of a subsidiary and the market appreciation and gain on disposal of marketable securities of $6,081,000 (net of taxes).

Net income for six months 1997 was $29,115,000 or $1.14 per share which includes gain on sale of company's investments in PCI Services Inc on October 11, 1996, and NutraMax on December 31, 1996, aggregating $37,175,000 (net of tax) and extraordinary loss of $6,926,000 (net of tax) or $0.27 per share on acquisition, at a premium, of certain of company's debt and write-off of related deferred charges.
Net loss from continuing operations for six months ended March 31, 1996, was $1,097,000 or $0.04 per share.
